title: Complete maintained cheat command hints in the console
changes: Offer arm and disarm completion and the explicit all argument; show localized contextual syntax for prepare, apply-once, arm and disarm without inventing source identities or preview tokens.
validation: Frozen offline Windows GNU release and test builds passed with 1915 source files and no drift. Four Wine completion tests passed, including English and Italian hints.

An isolated paused Wine/Xvfb command console showed the completed arm and disarm all drafts and their English hints; visual screenshots were reviewed, neither draft was submitted, and the guest, session pins and protected inputs remained unchanged.
limitations: Real IME composition and keyboard layouts, native Windows, Linux and physical controllers remain unverified. The captured GUI uses English; Italian hints were covered by Wine tests.
